faq.heading: Everything we answer before you even ask.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: Ideally 24 hours. Last-minute requests accepted based on availability — WhatsApp for an instant reply.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
items.a: Yes, free up to 24h before. WhatsApp or email — we adjust right away.

items.q: How do I pay?
items.a: Cash or card to the driver on arrival. No deposit required by default.

items.q: Is there a deposit?
items.a: Not by default. Optional deposit to lock in the round-trip discount.

items.q: Can I pay by card?
items.a: Yes. Visa, Mastercard, Amex — terminal in every vehicle.

items.q: Where does my driver meet me?
items.a: In the arrivals hall, past customs, with a sign bearing your name. Photo and WhatsApp number sent 24h before.

items.q: What if my flight is delayed?
items.a: We track your flight. Free waiting up to 60 minutes after landing.

items.q: What if I can't find my driver?
items.a: Call or WhatsApp +33 6 34 30 12 92. We'll find you right away.

items.q: What if I have more luggage than expected?
items.a: For the Tesla: 3 large suitcases or 2 large + 2 small maximum. If you have more luggage, ask for a van directly.

items.q: Can we make a stop along the way?
items.a: Yes. Price confirmed on WhatsApp depending on the detour. Short stops often free.

items.q: Can I change destination mid-trip?
items.a: Yes, within reason. The driver adjusts the rate with you.

items.q: Is there Wi-Fi and charging?
items.a: USB chargers in every vehicle. Wi-Fi available on request in the Tesla.

items.q: Can we smoke in the car?
items.a: No. 100% non-smoking vehicles, including vapes.

items.q: Do you have child seats?
items.a: Yes, free. Infant carrier (0–1 yr), child seat (1–3 yr), booster (3–10 yr). Tell us the ages.

items.q: Can we travel with a pet?
items.a: Small dogs in a carrier or travel bag, yes. WhatsApp for larger animals.

items.q: Do you offer accessible transfers?
items.a: Yes. WhatsApp with your needs — we adapt vehicle and assistance.

items.q: Can I book for someone else?
items.a: Yes. Provide the passenger's name and WhatsApp at booking.

items.q: Are there night or weekend surcharges?
items.a: No. Flat pricing 24/7, every day of the week.

items.q: Are tolls included?
items.a: Yes, everything included. Nothing to add on arrival.

items.q: And tipping?
items.a: Never expected. Always appreciated if the service pleased you.
